title: Graph-Based Discovery of Mathematical Software Communities and Publication-to-Community Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.16455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research software forms distinct co-usage communities that span traditional disciplinary boundaries, yet the structure of these communities remains largely unexplored. We present a graph-based framework for discovering mathematical software communities and predicting their association with research publications. We construct a software co-usage network from publication-software relationships using a curated swMATH dataset and subsequently apply community detection method, revealing a heterogeneous landscape of mathematical software communities. We formulate publication-to-community mapping as a multi-label classification task and further investigate whether community membership can be predicted from lightweight scholarly metadata. Specifically, we compare two feature representations of scientific publications: Mathematics Subject Classification (MSC) and title-based embeddings. translated_title: 基于图的数学软件社区发现与出版物到社区预测
translated_abstract: 研究软件形成了跨越传统学科界限的独特共使用社区，然而这些社区的结构在很大程度上尚未被探索。我们提出了一个基于图的框架，用于发现数学软件社区并预测其与研究出版物的关联。我们利用精选的swMATH数据集，从出版物-软件关系中构建软件共使用网络，随后应用社区检测方法，揭示了数学软件社区的异质性景观。我们将出版物到社区的映射表述为一个多标签分类任务，并进一步研究社区成员资格是否可以从轻量级学术元数据中预测。具体来说，我们比较了科学出版物的两种特征表示：数学学科分类（MSC）和基于标题的嵌入。在一系列模型中，结构化MSC表示优于基于标题的嵌入，表明学科分类编码是预测社区成员资格的强大且可解释的信号。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于图的框架，利用软件共使用网络发现数学软件社区，并证明数学学科分类（MSC）元数据能有效预测出版物所属的软件社区。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a graph-based framework to discover mathematical software communities from co-usage networks and demonstrates that Mathematics Subject Classification (MSC) metadata effectively predicts publication-to-community membership.
